correctness.rationale: Each directed chain transports one binary grain at unit speed, and target vertices receive at most one grain per round, proving the exact firing sets. Every auxiliary vertex is contained in exactly one firing simplex, with an anchor target in the same simplex; deleting these dominated vertices yields compatible strong collapses at all filtration stages. The six-vertex projective-plane triangulation has integral Smith diagonal of nine ones and a two. The standalone replay checks 166 small antichains and the torsion example; finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.
